audio.scope: Four microphones are a comparison candidate, not proof of far-field recognition or full-band beamforming. PTT mono testing remains possible. No local loudspeaker in this thermal allocation; TV/audio output external.

thermal.scope: All continuous power allocations, not measurements or peak ratings. External USB loads disabled initially or separately budgeted. DC loss assumed inside enclosure; external AC adapter heat excluded. Actual fan P-Q, pressure drop, temperatures and noise HOLD.
